scheme_name: Skill Development Training - 90 Days Residential Skill Development Training Programme
description:
The Skill Development Training - 90 Days Residential Skill Development Training Programme is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India to enhance the employability of youth across the country. 

This program was introduced under the Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana which was launched in 2014. 

The primary objective of this initiative is to provide skill development training to rural youth aged between 15 and 35 years. 

The program aims to train approximately 1 million youth annually. 

The training is designed to equip participants with skills that are aligned with the needs of the industry. 

The 90-day residential training program focuses on various sectors such as construction, hospitality, retail, and information technology. 

The program is implemented through a network of training partners who are responsible for conducting the training sessions. 

These training partners include non-governmental organizations, private sector companies, and government institutions. 

The training is conducted in a residential format to ensure that participants have access to a conducive learning environment. 

Participants are provided with accommodation, meals, and training materials at no cost. 

The program also includes a practical component where participants gain hands-on experience in their chosen field. 

Upon successful completion of the training, participants receive a certificate that is recognized by the National Skill Development Corporation. 

The program also aims to provide placement assistance to participants. 

The placement assistance includes connecting participants with potential employers and providing guidance on job applications. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme includes a stipend of INR 2500 per month for the duration of the training. 

In addition to the stipend, participants are also eligible for a one-time tool kit allowance of INR 5000 upon completion of the training. 

The program is designed to be inclusive and encourages participation from marginalized communities. 

Special provisions are made for women and differently-abled individuals to ensure their participation in the training program. 

The eligibility criteria for the program include being a resident of India and being within the age limit of 15 to 35 years. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply for this program. 

However, candidates must demonstrate a willingness to learn and develop new skills. 

The application process for the program is straightforward and can be completed online. 

Interested candidates can visit the official website of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 

They need to fill out the application form with their personal details and submit it along with any required documents. 

The required documents typically include proof of age, proof of residence, and an Aadhar card. 

After submitting the application, candidates will receive a confirmation regarding their enrollment in the training program. 

The training sessions are conducted throughout the year, and candidates can join at various intervals. 

The program is designed to be flexible to accommodate the needs of participants. 

The implementing authority for this program is the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 

The National Skill Development Corporation plays a crucial role in overseeing the implementation and monitoring of the program. 

Contact details for the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship are available on their official website. 

The program has been successful in enhancing the employability of youth in rural areas. 

As of 2023, over 1.5 million youth have benefited from this initiative since its inception. 

The program has also contributed to reducing the skill gap in various industries. 

Feedback from participants indicates a high level of satisfaction with the training received. 

The program has been recognized for its role in promoting entrepreneurship among youth. 

Many participants have gone on to start their own businesses after completing the training. 

The government continues to invest in expanding the reach of this program to more rural areas. 

In 2022, an additional budget of INR 500 crores was allocated to enhance the program's infrastructure. 

The program also collaborates with various industry partners to ensure that the training is relevant and up-to-date. 

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of the training modules. 

The government is committed to continuously improving the program based on feedback from participants and industry stakeholders. 

The Skill Development Training - 90 Days Residential Skill Development Training Programme is a vital step towards empowering the youth of India. 

By providing them with the necessary skills and training, the program aims to create a more skilled workforce. 

This initiative aligns with the broader goals of the Skill India Mission launched in 2015. 

The Skill India Mission aims to train over 400 million people in various skills by 2022. 

The 90 Days Residential Skill Development Training Programme is a key component of this mission. 

The program not only focuses on skill development but also promotes self-confidence among participants. 

It encourages youth to take charge of their careers and pursue their aspirations. 

The government is also exploring partnerships with international organizations to enhance the training curriculum. 

This will ensure that the training provided is globally competitive and meets international standards. 

Overall, the Skill Development Training - 90 Days Residential Skill Development Training Programme is a comprehensive initiative aimed at transforming the lives of rural youth in India. 

It provides them with the tools they need to succeed in the workforce and contribute to the economy. 

The program is a testament to the government's commitment to skill development and youth empowerment. 

With continued support and investment, it is expected to have a lasting impact on the lives of millions of young people across the country. 

The success of this program can serve as a model for similar initiatives in other countries. 

By focusing on practical skills and industry needs, the program is paving the way for a brighter future for India's youth. 

The government encourages all eligible youth to take advantage of this opportunity and enroll in the program. 

This initiative is a stepping stone towards achieving sustainable economic growth and development in India.
